action_history.rationale: Cold-start scenario with only 12 data points in 2D and a large batch size of 16. The yield distribution is highly skewed (median 0.3 vs max 73), indicating a narrow productive region amidst a mostly flat near-zero landscape. Thompson sampling is ideal for batch_size=16 as it naturally provides diverse candidates while still being drawn toward promising regions. Using matern_2.5 kernel as default for a physical process with min_noise_low to let the GP learn noise freely given the wide dynamic range. No warp needed yet — with only 12 points the GP may not reliably fit warp parameters, and we can reassess after this batch provides 28 total points. The priority is to broadly map the space (especially around the high-yield region near T~370-390, pH~5-5.6 where the max was observed) while also exploring under-sampled areas.
